title: Golden Mediterranean Uni Skillet
description: A flavorful and nutritious skillet dish featuring uni, tempeh, and a blend of Mediterranean spices, perfect for a quick and easy dinner.
instructions: Preheat the cast-iron skillet over medium-high heat.
Add the olive oil and cook the tempeh until golden brown, about 5 minutes.
Add the garlic, garam masala, cumin, paprika, salt, and black pepper to the skillet. Cook for 1 minute.
Add the uni to the skillet and cook until warmed through, about 2-3 minutes.
Add the cherry tomatoes to the skillet and cook until they start to release their juices, about 2-3 minutes.
Crumble the feta cheese into the skillet and stir to combine.
Transfer the skillet to the oven and bake at 400°F (200°C) for 10-12 minutes, or until the cheese is melted and bubbly.
Remove the skillet from the oven and let it cool for a few minutes.
Serve the golden Mediterranean uni skillet hot, garnished with fresh herbs if desired.
